items.text: Final report: San Francisco ruled out WR Mike Evans (ribs/Achilles), WR Deebo Samuel (hamstring), DE Nick Bosa (knee/calf), LBs Luke Gifford and Garret Wallow and S Marques Sigle; WR Christian Kirk, CB Upton Stout and S Siran Neal are questionable. WR Ricky Pearsall is out for the season.

Final report: Atlanta ruled out RB Brian Robinson (hamstring), OT Michael Jerrell (bicep), LB Divine Deablo (forearm) and DB Billy Bowman Jr. (hamstring); questionable include CBs A.J. Terrell (groin, back from IR), Avieon Terrell and C.J. Henderson, DEs Za'Darius Smith and Samson Ebukam and DT Gervon Dexter.

adjust.reason: San Francisco is without its top receivers Mike Evans and Deebo Samuel (Pearsall already lost) plus Nick Bosa and three other defenders; Atlanta's absences (Robinson, Deablo, Bowman, a backup tackle) are smaller, though several Falcons defenders are questionable.
